chunks: Whoever performs four hajj pilgrimages will never be afflicted by the compression of the grave. When he dies, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will fashion the hajj pilgrimages that he performed into a beautiful form, the finest that forms can be, before his eyes; it will perform salat (prayer) in the interior of his grave until Allah, Mighty and Majestic, raises him from his grave, and the reward of that salat (prayer) shall belong to him. And know that one rak'ah of that salat (prayer) is equal to a thousand rak'ahs of the salat (prayer) of human beings.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward of performing four hajj pilgrimages in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a great virtue of repeatedly performing hajj (pilgrimage), stating that four hajj pilgrimages protect a person from the compression of the grave. It also depicts the performed hajj as taking on a beautiful form in the grave, worshipping on the person's behalf until resurrection, with its reward granted to them.
